title: Simple Tahini Sauce
summary: Tahini whisked with water until smooth and creamy, seasoned with lemon juice, garlic and salt.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Whisk in water
steps.text: Put the tahini in the bowl and whisk in the water a little at a time. It will thicken at first, then loosen into a smooth, creamy sauce.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Whisk in the lemon juice, garlic and salt.

steps.title: Adjust
steps.text: Add another spoonful of water if you want it thinner.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Drizzle over roast cauliflower, grilled vegetables or falafel.

tips: Stir the tahini jar well first; the oil separates.
Cold water makes a paler, fluffier sauce.
It thickens in the fridge; loosen with water.
Finish with a drizzle of olive oil.
storage: Refrigerate in a covered container for up to 4 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
